name: useGemini
summary: Cloud Gemini chat with real multi-turn history.
plain: Talks to the full Gemini model over the network. Much more capable than the on-device model, but it needs an API key and a connection. Replies carry real token counts and timings from the API.
description: Wraps ai.chats.create from @google/genai on gemini-3.8-flash with a system instruction, so history is maintained by the SDK rather than re-sent by hand. Token counts come from the response usageMetadata and latency is measured around the call. Replies stream through sendMessageStream, so partial fills in as chunks arrive and lastFirstChunkMs records time to first token. There is no simulated fallback: without a key, sendMessage appends a system-role message explaining how to configure one. The key is read from SecureStore, never from source.

returns.name: messages
returns.desc: Conversation so far. Role system means a local error, not model output.

returns.name: isLoading
returns.desc: True while a reply is in flight.

returns.name: hasApiKey
returns.desc: Whether a key is configured. Check this before offering cloud features.

returns.name: partial
returns.desc: Text streamed so far for the in-flight reply. Empty between turns; render it for a live typing effect.

returns.name: lastFirstChunkMs
returns.desc: Time to the first streamed chunk of the last reply, in ms. Null before the first reply.

returns.name: lastPromptTokens
returns.desc: Token count returned by the last countTokens() call. Null until you call it.

returns.name: lastGrounding
returns.desc: What the last grounded reply searched for (queries) and which URIs it used (sources). Null when grounding was off or the model chose not to search.

returns.name: safetyThreshold
returns.desc: Blocking threshold applied to all four harm categories. Default leaves the API defaults in place.

returns.name: searchGrounding
returns.desc: Whether the googleSearch tool is attached to the session.

returns.name: availableModels
returns.desc: Models the API lists for this key, filtered to Gemini text models. Falls back to a curated default list when offline or unconfigured.

returns.name: temperature
returns.desc: Sampling temperature sent with the session, default `0.4`.

returns.name: systemInstruction
returns.desc: The instruction the session was created with. Defaults to the PixelKit assistant instruction.

returns.name: thinkingBudget
returns.desc: Thinking tokens requested, default `0` (off). Above zero, `thinkingConfig` is sent with the session.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Latest failure message, or `null`. Failures are also logged and counted.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Cloud model: reachable only with a key and a network route.

actions.name: sendMessage(prompt)
actions.desc: Sends a turn and appends the reply with its latency and token count.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.desc: The user's turn. Blank input is ignored.

actions.output: Resolves when the reply arrives. Without an API key it appends a system-role message explaining that instead; API errors arrive the same way rather than as a rejection.

actions.name: setSelectedModel(model)
actions.desc: Switches the cloud model and resets the chat session, because the model is fixed when the session is created.

inputs.name: model
inputs.desc: An id from availableModels, which the API lists for your key.

actions.output: Returns nothing; the next turn starts a new session on that model.

actions.name: setTopP(n) / setTopK(n) / setTemperature(n) / setMaxOutputTokens(n)
actions.desc: Generation parameters. They are fixed when the session is created, so changing one starts a fresh session.

inputs.name: value
inputs.desc: Top-p 0 to 1, top-k a positive integer, temperature typically 0 to 2, max output tokens the reply ceiling.

actions.name: setThinkingBudget(tokens)
actions.desc: Thinking tokens requested from the model. Zero disables thinking, and only a value above zero is sent.

inputs.name: tokens
inputs.desc: Token budget for reasoning before the reply. Costs latency and tokens.

actions.output: Returns nothing; applied to the next session.

actions.name: setSystemInstruction(text)
actions.desc: Sets the standing instruction the session is created with, and resets the chat session.

inputs.name: text
inputs.desc: How the model should behave. Empty falls back to the PixelKit assistant instruction.

actions.output: Returns nothing; the next turn starts a fresh session carrying that instruction.

actions.name: setSafety(threshold)
actions.desc: Sets one blocking threshold across all four harm categories (harassment, hate speech, sexually explicit, dangerous content) and resets the chat session.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.desc: 'default' sends no safetySettings at all. Otherwise BLOCK_NONE, BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE or BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE from @google/genai.

actions.output: Returns nothing; the next turn starts a fresh session carrying that threshold.

actions.name: setSearchGroundingEnabled(enabled)
actions.desc: Attaches or removes the googleSearch tool, letting the model search the web before answering. Resets the chat session.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.desc: True to ground replies in Google Search. The model decides per turn whether to actually search.

actions.output: Returns nothing. When a turn does search, lastGrounding carries the queries and source URIs.

actions.name: countTokens(text)
actions.desc: Asks the API how many tokens a prompt costs on the selected model, before you send it.

inputs.name: text
inputs.desc: The prompt to measure. Blank input returns null without a network call.

actions.output: Resolves to the token count, or null without a key or when the call fails. Also written to lastPromptTokens.

actions.name: clearMessages()
actions.desc: Clears the history and resets the chat session, so the next turn starts with no context.

actions.name: setApiKey(key)
actions.desc: Swaps the key in memory and resets the chat session.

inputs.name: key
inputs.desc: The Gemini API key, or null to clear it. Persisting it is the job of saveApiKey().

actions.output: Returns nothing. hasApiKey updates immediately and availableModels is refreshed in the background.

agentNote: Keys come from saveApiKey and live in SecureStore. Never hardcode one, and never fabricate a reply when the key is missing.
